FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Threaded Roadbuilder
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Performance update: the calculation of the Minimum Spanning Tree for the road builder now uses threading!

patchNoteLines.li: Use a background thread for computation of the road builder MST

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Coalescing Settlement Terminology
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Replaces "colony" with "settlement" in the Empire UI when referring to Empire settlements.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates many UI strings to use "settlement" instead of "colony"

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Translation key update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates all of Empire's translation keys to use an "FC" prefix.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates translation keys that don't already have an "FC" prefix to have one. Touches many files.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Expanded production bonuses
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Expands the number of things that affect resource production. Now accounts for tile mutators, as well as a number of tile fields like rainfail, animal density, and pollution.

patchNoteLines.li: Buildings can now set tile mutator block/allowlists
New TileMutatorResourceExtension can be patched onto tile mutators to let them grant production bonuses/maluses
New ResourceProductionExtension_TileField allows various tile fields to affect resource production

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tech Progression Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates Empire's tech progression to be def-defined. This makes it much easier for other mods to change the thresholds for advancing the Empire faction's tech level. There's also a new mod setting to ignore research entirely and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player's (for use with mods like Tech Advancing).

patchNoteLines.li: New mod setting to ignore research and pin the Empire faction's tech level to the player faction's
Change the tech level gates to be defined through XML

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Raid with no event fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Hardens the code against the possibility of a settlement falling under attack with no associated event.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds various protections to clean up a settlement's "under attack" state if there's no corresponding event

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Further "Settlement" Cleanup
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Further UI cleanup to get "settlement" everywhere it should be

patchNoteLines.li: Centralizes events into an FCEventManager that handles actually adding or removing events to the queue.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tile landmark support
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Expands the support for Tile Mutators to include Tile Landmarks.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new TileLandmarkResourceExtension that can be xml patched onto landmarks to make them grant special bonuses to Empire settlements.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Found Settlement Window Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new window on Found New Settlement screen to show non-resource bonuses/maluses provided by the tile

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Biome Stat Modifiers
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Allows biomes to set biome-specific stat modifiers, in addition to the resource bonuses.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds and wires up a FCStatModifier list to BiomeResourceDef, enabling biomes to add bonuses or maluses to non-resource stats

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds several more defensive null guards.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds numerous null guards. Some are unlikely to ever trigger, but better safe than sorry...
